notes.interactionP95Ms: Applies to editor input/cursor/run, Explorer expansion/search, first result batch, grid/Agent scroll, permission/reconnect, ERD drag, cancellation, and resize checkpoints. Explicit background/format budgets are listed in actionP95Ms.
notes.idleIpcCallsPerMinute: Measured for ten visible idle seconds and normalized to one minute; startup IPC is reported separately.
notes.longTaskFallback: When the WebView Long Tasks API is unavailable, frame gaps are recorded and the 50 ms long-task checkpoint remains explicitly unsupported instead of being treated as zero.
